{{Top}}
[[File:DropshipDeployment-TSS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A dropship deploying troops]]
A '''dropship''' (or '''drop ship'''), also known as a '''drop shuttle''', was any craft designed to transport [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], supplies, or vehicles to the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], either for peaceful purposes or in the case of planetary assaults. Dropships were commonly deployed from [[Starship/Legends|starships]] capable of atmospheric flight or landing. Most dropships lacked [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and boasted relatively few armaments or defenses.
